name: Zyon Robinson
strengths: Robinson creates separation with sudden releases and clean breaks from the perimeter.
Robinson tracks the ball through traffic and wins with strong hands at the catch point.
Robinson turns short throws into chunk plays with stride length after the catch.
weaknesses: Robinson still needs to add mass to his 175-pound frame to play through SEC press every down.
comparison: Robinson comps to Chris Olave — 6-1 polished perimeter WR with sudden separation habits and clean tracking at the catch point.
projection: Robinson projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at WR (packages Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC receiver — the McEachern separator who can win outside and finish drives.
schemeFit: Robinson fits a perimeter WR room that values separation and clean catch habits as the frame fills.
